# Game data

`freedoom1.wad` is the unmodified Freedoom: Phase 1 IWAD from version 0.13.0.

- Release: https://github.com/freedoom/freedoom/releases/tag/v0.13.0
- Download: https://github.com/freedoom/freedoom/releases/download/v0.13.0/freedoom-0.13.0.zip
- Release ZIP SHA256: `3f9b264f3e3ce503b4fb7f6bdcb1f419d93c7b546f4df3e874dd878db9688f59`
- License: BSD-3-Clause; see `FREEDOOM-LICENSE.txt`.
- Credits: `FREEDOOM-CREDITS.txt` and `FREEDOOM-CREDITS-MUSIC.txt`.

The ZIP checksum was checked against the official release's CHECKSUM file.
The full Phase 1 IWAD is included so all four episodes remain available and
level progression uses the original data. It is 28,795,076 bytes uncompressed.
The engine does not play sound, but the IWAD has not been edited to remove it.

An optional local `doom1.wad` can be used for the original DOOM regression tests.
It is ignored by Git and is never included in the package or web zip.
